details.open_source_desc: This project is open-sourced on GitHub
details.background_desc: The purpose of this blog is to record daily learning, technical sharing and project experience. I hope to practice the technologies involved in full-stack development, system design and DevOps deployment through this project. In the old version of the blog, some functional designs were relatively simplistic. Therefore, the brand-new NoteForest X version fixes the bugs existing in the old version and expands some new features.
details.frontend_list_1: Nuxt4 —— Used to provide SSR/SSG capabilities
details.frontend_list_2: Vue3 + TypeScript —— Core development framework and programming language
details.frontend_list_3: Vite —— Serves as a high-performance build tool
details.frontend_list_5: md-editor-v3 —— Used for Markdown text editing and rendering
details.frontend_list_6: GSAP, Pinia, Tailwind CSS, Flag Icons —— Animation, state management, styling and icon libraries
details.frontend_desc: The reason for choosing Vue is its lightweight architecture, high efficiency and comprehensive ecosystem. Meanwhile, I have been using Vue for a long time and am very familiar with its development paradigm.
details.backend_list_1: Golang —— High-performance, concise core backend programming language
details.backend_list_2: Custom REST API based on GIN —— Provides data interfaces for articles, illustration collections and user systems
details.backend_list_3: Redis —— Used for caching, session storage and query acceleration
details.backend_list_4: MySQL/MariaDB —— Persistent storage for the corresponding paths of articles and illustrations
details.backend_list_5: Anubis —— Lightweight web AI firewall utility
details.backend_list_6: Docker + Nginx + pm2 —— Underlying tools for deployment and runtime
details.backend_desc: The core design philosophy of the backend is to maintain simplicity and high efficiency, and separate business logic from data processing into different layers as much as possible to improve maintainability.
